THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 I hereby give notice for information of the public, that the notice EOG 08 - 0019 in the Gazette No. 2343/27 and dated 02.08.2023 published under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act should be amended as follows: Description of the land/servitude to be acquired: Two allotments of land in total extent of about 0.0197 Hectare, bearing Lot Nos. 235 and 236 in the Surveyor General's Cadastral Map No. 420214 dated 31.08.2022 and in sheet No. 11, block No. 01, situated at the Village of Idangapola, in Narampola Grama Niladhari Division, No. 725, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mallawapitiya, in Kurunegala District, North Western Province and bounded as follows: 01. Lot No. 235 Name of the Land: Not known; Claimant: State; Present usage of the land: Deduru Oya; Extent: 0.0130 Hectare.

Boundaries: North: Lot Nos. 196, 237, 236 and 234; East: Lot No. 234; South: Lot Nos. 234 and 196; West: Lot No. 196. Required for the protection of water source of Deduru Oya Water Supply Project. 02. Lot No. 236 Name of the Land: Koongahamulawatta and Asliyadda; Claimant: State; Present usage of the land: Shrub; Extent: 0.0037 Hectare. Boundaries: North: Lot Nos. 237 and 234; East: Lot No. 235; South: Lot No. 235; West: Lot Nos. 235 and 196. Required for the protection of water source of Deduru Oya Water Supply Project.
